Data Processing Agreement (DPA)

Contractual terms governing the processing of personal data on behalf of our enterprise and self-hosted customers under the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).

Last updated: September 10, 2026

1. Scope and roles#

This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") applies to the processing of personal data by ClockTime, Inc. ("Processor") on behalf of the customer ("Controller") in connection with the ClockTime service.

2. Obligations of processor#

Processor agrees to:

  • Process data only on documented instructions from Controller.
  • Ensure persons authorized to process data have committed to confidentiality.
  • Assist Controller in fulfilling data subject requests under Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) Chapter III.

3. Technical and organizational security#

Processor maintains robust security measures:

  • Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).
  • Automated vulnerability scanning and annual third-party penetration testing.
  • Strict role-based access control (RBAC) and multi-factor authentication for all infrastructure access.

4. Authorized sub-processors#

Processor engages verified infrastructure providers (e.g. AWS, Cloudflare) for hosting and edge routing. Controller will be notified of any changes to sub-processors at least 30 days in advance.

5. International data transfers#

Where data transfers outside the European Economic Area (EEA) occur, Processor relies on standard contractual clauses (SCCs) adopted by the European Commission.

6. Audit and compliance#

Processor makes available all necessary information to demonstrate compliance with Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) Article 28 and allows for reasonable security audits upon request.
